title: Length preservation under repeated word updates
statement: Define a map $T$ on finite Boolean words recursively by $T([]) = []$, $T(\mathrm{true}::v) = \mathrm{false}::v$, and $T(\mathrm{false}::v) = \mathrm{true}::T(v)$. For every finite Boolean word $u$ and every natural number $i$, applying $T$ repeatedly $i$ times to $u$ preserves its length.
